04_strip_model.text: Works as it should.. It’s nice to buy something and use it right away. I put my Sim card in it, works perfectly. No having to call phone carriers to unlock codes just put your Sim card in it, set it up like a new phone would be set up.

As for the functionality of the phone, it works great. My sim card runs on GSM, so I needed an IMEI phone, and the description on amazon said it supported GSM sim card carriers, so that’s one of the reasons I made this purchase. I was able to make calls, texts, and use my cellular data immediately once I was done setting up the phone. As a side note, this phone actually runs with IMEI and MEID, so any sim card carrier would’ve worked with it, which comforting to know. The sound also works great. I was worried about this, especially, because I was reading the negative reviews, and they were saying the earbuds sound was hollow, but for me, it wasn’t that way.

But it works fine now and seems to have decent battery life so that’s a plus.

(go to the settings... select general... Select about... then scroll till you see carrier lock... it should say (NO SIM RESTRICTIONS)... that’s how you know it’s unlocked to any carrier. I very recommend, do your research before purchasing. Enjoy your day

07_rewrite.text: Perfect cosmetically but buyer beware. This phone was suppose to be unlocked to any carrier. My airtalk wireless sims card would not work in it. I ended up have to get an H20 (knockoff AT&T) phone plan and sims card. Which mean I had to change my number and was a head ache all the way around. But it works fine now and seems to have decent battery life so that’s a plus.

As for the functionality of the phone, it works great. My sim card runs on GSM, so I needed an IMEI phone, and the description on amazon said it supported GSM sim card carriers, so that’s one of the reasons I made this purchase. I was able to make calls, texts, and use my cellular data immediately once I was done setting up the phone. As a side note, this phone actually runs with IMEI and MEID, so any sim card carrier would’ve worked with it, which comforting to know. The sound also works great. I was worried about this, especially, because I was reading the negative reviews, and they were saying the earbuds sound was hollow, but for me, it wasn’t that way.
